findings.evidenceJa: 目に見えるほどの殺気を伴って笑う
findings.governingReading: The old insect-user laughs with killing intent so palpable that it seems visible.
findings.explanation: Zouken's almost visible killing intent becomes hostility in the surrounding insects. His chuckle remains, but the direct description of his murderous intent is lost.

findings.highlight: Even one as unlucky as you must understand
findings.evidenceJa: 巡りの悪いおぬしでも理解できたろう
findings.governingReading: 巡りの悪いおぬしでも理解できたろう taunts his slow uptake in understanding repeated reports, not fortune in the event.
findings.explanation: A slow-witted person becomes an unlucky person.
